keyPoints: Paudhe apna bhojan khud banate hain (swayamposhi), par amarbel aur ghatpippal jaise kuch paudhe bhojan ke liye doosre paudhon ya keedon par nirbhar hote hain (parposhi).
Pattiyon ki satah par chhote-chhote chhed randra (stomata) hote hain jinse carbon dioxide andar aati hai, oxygen bahar jaati hai aur paani ki bhaap nikalti hai.
Jaden mitti se paani aur khanij lavan sokhti hain; tane me maujood xylem nalikaen inhe pattiyon tak pahunchati hain.
Pattiyon me bana bhojan phloem nalikaon ke jariye paudhe ke har hisse — jad, tane, phal aur beej — tak pahunchta hai.
Paudhe bhi saans lete hain — din me prakash sanshleshan ke saath-saath aur raat me keval shwasan hota hai, jisme oxygen lekar carbon dioxide chhodi jaati hai.
Paudhe bekar padarth pattiyan girakar, chhaal utaarkar ya gond-ras ke roop me bahar nikaalte hain; kuch bekar padarth purani pattiyon me jama kar diye jaate hain.
Aam galti: samajhna ki paudhe sirf din me jeevit prakriya karte hain; shwasan, parivahan aur vriddhi din-raat lagatar chalte rehte hain.

title: Paudhon me Jeevan Prakriyayein
